title: English Practice Quiz 0186
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Which word has the /ʃ/ sound as in 'ship'?
Choose the correct word: ___ going to arrive soon.
questions.explanation: They're is the contraction of they are.

questions.question: There is ___ water in the bottle.
questions.explanation: A little is used with uncountable nouns.

questions.question: We ___ here since 2022.
questions.explanation: Since gives a starting point; the present perfect connects the past to now.

questions.question: Mount Everest is ___ highest mountain in the world.
